capabilities: Chat with an agent grounded in notes, properties, tasks, links, Bases and CSV files
Review note creation, rewriting, moving, renaming and deletion as diffs before applying
Run reusable skills and multi-step workflows stored as vault files
Search the vault by keyword or optional embeddings
disambiguation: Not a grammar or verb-conjugation tool; it is an AI agent that reads and edits vault documents.
extras: Desktop only; interface and agent follow Obsidian's language (Korean or English). Optional Windows x64 offline pack bundles the database runtime, tokenizer table and a local embedding model; otherwise those files download on first use. Model providers may charge for usage; no telemetry.
intentEvidence: Verbex began as a fork of Smart Composer (MIT, Heesu Suh) and was redeveloped from there.
problem: Asking an AI about a vault usually means pasting notes by hand, and letting it edit files risks changes you did not approve or cannot undo.

requires.name: Model provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio or OpenAI-compatible endpoint)

summary: AI agent that chats over vault notes, CSV files and Bases, and applies note edits only after diff approval, with restorable checkpoints.
